name: Asana
author: Thomas Torggler
description: Your Asana My Tasks list, grouped by section, in a keyboard-driven bar popup.

barWidget.description: Bar icon with the number of tasks due today or overdue; the popup shows My Tasks grouped by section, like Asana's list view.

schema.label: Workspace
schema.description: Workspace name or gid. Empty uses your first workspace.

schema.label: Bar count
schema.description: due: overdue plus due today. open: every open task. none: icon only.
